points: Iranian missile and drone barrage targeted Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem base; Kuwaiti air defenses intercepted projectiles at 1930Z, marking direct Iranian kinetic action against a Gulf state. Kuwaiti army confirmed Iranian forces targeted Kuwaiti territory near the Persian Gulf. (Source: @VahidOnline/77440, @shin_persian/8431, @New_security8200/202913)

Unconfirmed OSINT indicates a U.S. strike hit the Shahid Zeyn al-Din NAJA Barracks south of Abhar, Zanjan Province, at geolocation 36.08563, 49.22618, suggesting expanded U.S. targeting of Iranian security infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/8430)

Fox News discussion revealed potential U.S. target set including Damavand power plant supplying 40% of Tehran's electricity, Kuh-e Klang (Pickaxe Mountain) suspected uranium enrichment site with dolomite rock complicating air strikes, and South Pars gas field; B-1 bombers from UK and B-2 from Whiteman AFB noted. (Source: @VahidOnline/77439)

Multiple explosions reported across western Iran: Ahvaz witnesses described window-rattling blasts; Iranian media reported explosions in Bushehr and Qeshm Island; intense jet activity observed over Ilam Province. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77484, @rodast_omiddana/77485, @New_security8200/202897, @shin_persian/8439)

Two missiles launched from Cheghelondi (Biranjshahr-Khorramabad area) toward the west at approximately 11:00 local time, indicating possible Iranian missile readiness or test. (Source: @mamlekate/103981)
Claims circulated of German, French, British, and North Korean embassy evacuations in Tehran; France officially denied evacuation of its embassy. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93848, @SharghDaily/174013)
Iran's UN representative vowed to continue defending territorial integrity and sovereignty following aggressive U.S. attacks. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380323)

IRGC explicitly warned UK that any base used for attacks on Iran — referencing U.S. bombers operating from British bases — will become a target, escalating threat to NATO ally territory. (Source: @yediotnews25/133111)

Israeli intelligence assesses Iran may attack Israel soon; poster of new Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya displayed in Tehran's Palestine Square, signaling Hamas-Iran alignment. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93846, @yediotnews25/133121)

IDF forces neutralized three Palestinian attackers in separate stabbing incidents: at Ganim (Manasseh Brigade), Alon Moreh (Shomron Brigade), and Tunnel Checkpoint; attacker in Ganim identified as Palestinian policeman. (Source: @idf_telegram/24698, @idf_telegram/24693, @New_security8200/202908, @amitsegal/63305)
UK government stated its forces are prepared to defend Britain against any attack following IRGC threats. (Source: @yediotnews25/133123)

Stabbing attack at Ganim settlement area (Manasseh Brigade) near Jenin: one Israeli stabbed in leg, attacker neutralized by IDF force; forces continue operating in area. (Source: @idf_telegram/24698, @lelotsenzura/93844, @manniefabian/58834)
Stabbing attempt at Alon Moreh (Shomron Brigade): IDF received report, details under review, attacker neutralized. (Source: @idf_telegram/24693)

Attempted stabbing of female soldier at Tunnel Checkpoint: terrorist neutralized, no casualties; Magav forces arrested armed Hebron resident with knife. (Source: @New_security8200/202908, @N12chat/218899)
Attacker in Ganim incident identified as Palestinian policeman, indicating possible insider threat. (Source: @amitsegal/63305)
Fighter jets reported over southern Lebanon at maximum alert; artillery shelling reported on Al-Tahir area. (Source: @redlinkleb/32678, @redlinkleb/32654)
Lebanese internal security activated reporting bot for hostile drone or warplane activity, urging public to report sightings immediately. (Source: @redlinkleb/32685)

Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaydi affirmed Iraq's commitment to deepen strategic relations with Iran, expand economic cooperation across all fields, and continue role as regional dialogue hub. (Source: @SharghDaily/174012)
Ukrainian President Zelensky stated U.S. focus on Iran has weakened Ukraine's air defense and missile capabilities, diverting vital resources. (Source: @SharghDaily/174009)

Kuwaiti air defenses intercepted Iranian missiles and drones at 1930Z; Kuwaiti army announced Iranian forces targeted Kuwaiti territory near Persian Gulf, specifically Ali Al-Salem base. (Source: @shin_persian/8431, @VahidOnline/77440, @New_security8200/202913)

Trump accused Houthis of attacking two Saudi vessels, warning of major military punishment against Iran and Houthis if repeated; damages to be paid from Iranian funds held by U.S. (Source: @VahidOnline/77432, @naya_foriraq/85195, @Faytuks_Network/5644)
Trump approved 30-year U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal worth tens of billions, giving U.S. companies leading role in building Saudi nuclear program. (Source: @shin_persian/8428)
IRIB broadcaster urged Arab countries to evacuate immediately, signaling heightened regional tension. (Source: @kianmeli1/89985)
